changelog: Strict Proctored Air-Gap Internet Detection: Real-time background detection blocks desktop workspace immediately if Wi-Fi or Ethernet is connected
Automatic Session Resume: Seamlessly unlocks workspace the exact instant candidate disconnects from the internet
Desktop-Exclusive Enforcement: Feature strictly guards Windows and Linux desktop applications while leaving the web version unrestricted
UTF-8 Database Initialization: Resolves Windows cp1252 charmap encoding crash during offline startup
100% Offline execution engine: zero external CDN dependencies, local Monaco Editor, and offline database
Isolated user data and kernel state: SQLite DB and kernel connections stored in user AppData (no Program Files write permission issues)
Default installation path set to C:\Program Files\PyShield Studio with Browse directory picker
Full system-wide integration with HKLM and HKCU PATH environment updates
Interactive Windows setup wizard with desktop shortcut & PATH options
Native .ipynb notebook file association and Explorer context menu
